headline: Agents become accountable roles, not interchangeable chat windows.
lede: The product is not a smarter router. It is a structure for who may act, what context travels with the work, how work is claimed, and where responsibility stops.

items.label: [role:research]
items.title: Roles exist individually and relationally
items.body: An agent is defined by what it does and by the principals, domains, workflows, and other roles it works in relation to.

items.label: [blast:bounded]
items.title: Authority is explicit
items.body: Rights name the principal, domain, scope, action, conditions, and time. High-blast actions stop at a checkpoint instead of borrowing the operator's ambient credential.

items.label: [handoff:pull]
items.title: Work carries high-level context
items.body: Tasks enter declared workflows; eligible agents claim them and read the planning ascent instead of waiting for the operator to narrate every next move.

items.label: [attention:rare]
items.title: Intervention is the exception
items.body: Safe work advances unattended. The operator sees the decisions only they can make, with the record needed to decide.

status_note: The single-principal governance substrate is in daily use. Multi-operator ownership, delegated approval, distributed authority, and the full organizational operating system remain planned phases; the repository status is authoritative.
